description: This file contains functions related to RFC configuration management, including retrieving system event values, waiting for RFC processing completion, reading RFC properties via rbus or other mechanisms, executing system commands, handling string operations, and extracting scheduling information from configuration files.

methods.name: std::string getSyseventValue(const std::string & key)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a system event key by executing the 'sysevent get' command.

methods.name: void waitForRfcCompletion()
methods.description: Polls the system to wait until the RFC blob processing is marked as complete, or times out after several retries.

methods.name: int read_RFCProperty(const char * type,const char * key,char * out_value,int datasize)
methods.description: Reads the RFC property value either via rbus or fallback mechanism, returning success or failure.

methods.name: int executeCommandAndGetOutput(SYSCMD eSysCmd,const char * pArgs,std::string & result)
methods.description: Executes specific system commands and captures their output into a string.

methods.name: bool CheckSpecialCharacters(const std::string & str)
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: bool StringCaseCompare(const std::string & str1,const std::string & str2)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison between two strings.

methods.name: void RemoveSubstring(std::string & str,const std::string & toRemove)
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a substring from a string.

methods.name: std::string getCronFromDCMSettings()
methods.description: Reads the cron scheduling setting from configuration files and returns it.
